subject: Post-demo: Trial plan & environment decision (hosted vs VPC)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@novahealth.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Trial plan & environment decision (hosted vs VPC)

Hey Emma / Amit —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum.

Summary of ask: NovaHealth wants a 4-week trial to validate clinical note summarization latency and PII filtering on real traffic (anonymized where possible). We discussed three environment options:

- Hosted (Redwood API) — fastest to start, shared infra, SOC2 controls, lower setup overhead
- Dedicated sandbox — reserved capacity in our hosted fleet, customer-isolated GPU pool, moderate setup time
- VPC trial — private control plane with customer VPC peering (best for PHI/regulatory)

Proposed success criteria (draft — please confirm):
- Average per-request latency <= 650ms p50 on your production sample (batching profile TBD)
- End-to-end summary quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.75 vs clinical gold samples (we'll run evals)
- PII/PHI redaction: zero high-severity leakage on the 200-sample audit set
- Cost target: average token cost < $0.015 (after batching/quantization suggestions)

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) You confirm environment preference (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC) and any absolute constraints (e.g., no shared tenancy for PHI).
2) We (Redwood) deliver a one-page success criteria doc and a prep checklist by EOD Wed (attached: POC-success-criteria.xlsx).
3) Ops kickoff: once environment is agreed, we schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff (network, auth, sample data flow).
4) Sign MPA addendum for trial access (I’ll send DocuSign link once we align).

Can you confirm environment preference and whether your security/compliance team needs to be looped in before the kickoff?

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx
From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Patel <amit.patel@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial plan & environment decision (hosted vs VPC)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Short answers below:

Environment: VPC trial is our preference because we will be ingesting PHI during the trial (we can provide de-identified subsets but we need to validate in-situ behavior). If there’s a way to do a short pilot on hosted then switch to VPC for the full four weeks we can consider that, but our security team has a strong preference for no shared tenancy for PHI.

Success criteria: the draft items look good — we’ll add one more: redaction must preserve critical clinical terms (no over-redaction that removes diagnosis codes). I’ll attach a short audit sample and the clinical term list after I confirm internal approvals.

Timeline: we’re aiming to start the week of Aug 16. That gives our infra team time to accept the MPA and schedule a 2-hour window for peering and firewall rule changes.

Security stakeholders: I’ll loop in our InfoSec lead (Sally Cheng) and network lead (Amit — cc’d) for the kickoff.

—Emma
Emma Torres
Director of Product | NovaHealth
emma.torres@novahealth.com | +1 617-555-0123
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@novahealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial plan & environment decision (hosted vs VPC)

Emma / team —

VPC trial path is totally doable. High-level ops checklist for a short pre-kickoff read: (I’ll run these in parallel with legal).

Networking / connectivity:
- AWS VPC Peering or Transit Gateway (we support both). Please confirm whether you prefer peering or TGW.
- Public IP allowlist for control-plane callbacks (we’ll provide CIDR ranges).
- Egress rules for model telemetry and audit logs (we can stream to your S3 or deliver logs as encrypted bundles).

Authentication / secrets:
- We support short-lived cert-based auth for the trial or customer-managed static keys (we recommend certs).
- KMS/HSM integration is available if you need in-region key control.

Data handling / compliance:
- We’ll enable KV-prefix caching only for non-sensitive prefixes by default; for PHI workloads we'll disable cross-request caching unless requested.
- Audit logs: we'll turn on full token-level logging and deliver daily encrypted archives to your S3.

Ownership & ops contacts:
- Redwood technical owner: Karthik Iyer (inbound ops)
- Redwood network lead (peering): Marissa Cole
- NovaHealth network owner: Amit Patel
- NovaHealth InfoSec: Sally Cheng (TBD)

Estimated prep tasks and timeline (assuming kickoff week of Aug 16):
- Aug 6–10: Legal/MPA sign and exchange of architecture diagrams
- Aug 11–13: Network changes (peering, firewall rules)
- Aug 14–15: Dry-run with synthetic traffic and smoke tests
- Aug 16: Official trial start (4-week duration)

I’ve attached a network checklist that we’ll use on the kickoff call (network-requirements-checklist.docx).

If you prefer, I can also prepare a minimal-runbook for the trial that lists exact API endpoints, rate-limits, and escalation contacts.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: network-requirements-checklist.docx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@novahealth.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial plan & environment decision (hosted vs VPC)

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Emma. Quick confirmation and asks so we can lock the calendar: 

1) Environment: proceed with VPC trial. We’ll treat hosted-only as fallback if there’s an unexpected delay with peering.
2) Deliverables by Redwood (owner in parentheses):
   - Final success criteria spreadsheet (Jordan) — EOD Wed Aug 6 (updated with NovaHealth note on clinical term preservation)
   - DocuSign MPA addendum (Jordan) — will send Mon Aug 9
   - Ops runbook + peering IPs (Karthik) — draft by Aug 12

3) NovaHealth asks to confirm: preferred peering method (Peering vs TGW) and desired S3 bucket ARN for logs (or we can provide a temporary one).

4) Proposed kickoff: Tue Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 PT — technical (peering, auth, smoke test plan). If that doesn’t work, suggest two alternative windows and we’ll adapt.

If everyone is aligned I’ll lock the kickoff and send calendar invites + the DocuSign link next week. Thanks all — excited to get this running.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
